issues.description: The template's simulate_msd_one_round function has a return type annotation of list[float], but the problem statement and the solution both specify and implement a tuple[float, float] return (error rate, acceptance rate). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and cause type-related errors or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the return type annotation of simulate_msd_one_round in the template to tuple[float, float] (or update the problem statement to match), and ensure the docstring/signature consistently state the function returns (error_rate, acceptance_rate).
